title: 거래처 카탈로그 이미지 배치 및 글씨 기본값

actions.name: SAVE_DRAFT_OR_EXPORT
actions.write: existing catalog draft JSON or browser localStorage or downloaded file only

criteria.legacy: Missing settings retain square images and existing typography. Zero requested spacing is accepted but text safety gaps take precedence.
criteria.layout: Shared normalized cm-based layout for composer, preview, print and PPT. Square scale request 20–200 percent persists; actual image is capped to the available cell after reserving text height. Text includes every displayed field and explicit newline, with conservative wrapping. Image/text gap at least0.25cm and row gap0.35cm for normal viable layouts. Header space protected. Oversized text that cannot fit raises existing explicit warning/export failure instead of silent export.
criteria.fonts: Shared per-field font defaults, 6–48pt, persist in catalogFields; user explicitly saves browser defaults; stored draft overrides defaults.
criteria.sideEffects: No SQL/API write changes; no ERP probe needed for pure client layout. Existing catalog draft persistence is JSON-file based.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025 and 2026 identical week drafts preserve year and product/price identity when only layout changes.

dnspyEvidence.note: Existing native product identity remains untouched. Web-only catalog presentation settings; no shared MSSQL query or mutation changed and no new native behavior claimed.
